en: a special chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, an accident, etc.
ex: He's been confined to a wheelchair since the accident.
他从那次出事以后就离不开轮椅了。

zh: （商界或政界的）工于心计的人，进行复杂交易的人
en: a person who does a lot of complicated deals in business or politics, often in a dishonest way

zh: （船上的）操舵室，驾驶室
a person's area of expert knowledge or experience
if a pitch (= throw of the ball) is in your wheelhouse, it is in the area where it is easiest to hit
en: a small cabin with walls and a roof on a ship where the person controlling the direction in which the ship moves stands at the wheel
ex: The movie has superstar DiCaprio in a role that is right in his wheelhouse.
电影中，超级巨星狄卡普里奥（DiCaprio）的角色正好在他的驾驶室中。

zh: （骑自行车或摩托车将前轮抬起的）后轮支撑车技
en: a trick that you can do on a bicycle or motorcycle by balancing on the back wheel, with the front wheel off the ground
ex: to do a wheelie
做后轮支撑的特技

zh: （带盖的）有轮大垃圾筒
en: a large container with a lid (= cover) and wheels, that you keep outside your house and use for putting rubbish in

zh: 车轮修造工（尤指木轮的）
en: a person whose job is making and repairing wheels, especially wooden ones

zh: 喘；喘息；喘鸣
en: to breathe noisily and with difficulty
ex: He was coughing and wheezing all night.
他整夜又咳嗽又喘。

zh: 喘息的；喘鸣的；气喘吁吁的；呼哧呼哧响的
en: while making the high whistling sound that your chest makes when you cannot breathe easily

zh: 喘息的；喘鸣的；气喘吁吁的；呼哧呼哧响的
en: the fact of your chest making a high whistling sound when you cannot breathe easily

zh: 喘息的；喘鸣的；气喘吁吁的；呼哧呼哧响的
en: making the high, whistling sound that your chest makes when you cannot breathe easily
ex: I'm wheezy today.
我今天感到喘不上气来。

zh: 蛾螺（有些可食用）
en: a small shellfish that can be eaten

zh: 小狗；幼犬；（犬科动物的）幼兽
en: a young animal of the dog family; a puppy or cub

zh: 什么时候；何时；什么情况下；什么场合下
（用于时间的表达方式之后）在那时，其时
其时；当时；当场
en: at what time; on what occasion
ex: When did you last see him?
你上次什么时候见到他的？

zh: a song from the American Civil War which was popular with people on both sides. It was written in 1863 by Patrick Gilmore (1829-92) who was born in Ireland. The first verse is: “When Johnny comes marching home again, hurrah! Hurrah!We'll give him a hearty welcome then, hurrah! Hurrah!The men will cheer, the boys will shout,The ladies, they will all turn out,And we'll all feel gay, when Johnny comes marching home.”
en: a song from the American Civil War which was popular with people on both sides. It was written in 1863 by Patrick Gilmore (1829-92) who was born in Ireland. The first verse is: “When Johnny comes marching home again, hurrah! Hurrah!We'll give him a hearty welcome then, hurrah! Hurrah!The men will cheer, the boys will shout,The ladies, they will all turn out,And we'll all feel gay, when Johnny comes marching home.”

w: When the Saints Go Marching In
zh: one of the best-known traditional Dixielandsongs in the US. It is played every day in the French Quarter of New Orleans. The first verse is: “Oh, when the saints go marching in,Oh, when the saints go marching in,Oh, Lord, I want to be in that number,When the saints go marching in.”
en: one of the best-known traditional Dixielandsongs in the US. It is played every day in the French Quarter of New Orleans. The first verse is: “Oh, when the saints go marching in,Oh, when the saints go marching in,Oh, Lord, I want to be in that number,When the saints go marching in.”

zh: 从何处；从哪里
en: from where
ex: They returned whence they had come.
他们从哪里来又回到哪里去了。

zh: 在任何…的时候；无论何时；在任何…的情况下
每当；每次
别的什么时候（也可以）；任何时间（都行）
en: at any time that; on any occasion that
ex: You can ask for help whenever you need it.
你如果需要帮助随时可以提出来。

zh: 在哪里；到哪里；处于哪种情形
（用于表示地点或情况的词语后）在那（地方），到那（地方）
在那里；在该处；在该情况下
en: in or to what place or situation
ex: Where do you live?
你住在哪儿？

zh: （人或物）所在的地方；下落；行踪
en: the place where somebody/something is
ex: His whereabouts are/is still unknown.
他仍下落不明。

zh: （用以比较或对比两个事实）然而，但是，尽管
（用于正式文件中句子的开头）鉴于
en: used to compare or contrast two facts
ex: Some of the studies show positive results, whereas others do not.
有一些研究结果令人满意，然而其他的则不然。

zh: 凭此；借以；由于
en: by which; because of which
ex: They have introduced a new system whereby all employees must undergo regular training.
他们采用了新的制度，所有的雇员都必须定期培训。

zh: 其中；在那里；在那种情况下；以什么方式
en: in which place, situation or thing; in what way
ex: an organization wherein each employee is valued and respected
每个员工都受到重视和尊重的组织

zh: 关于什么；关于那个
en: of what or which
ex: I know whereof I speak (= I know a lot about what I am talking about).
我知道自己在说些什么。

zh: 然后；于是；随之；据此；因此
en: and then; as a result of this
ex: He told her she was a liar, whereupon she walked out.
他对她说她在说谎，她便愤然而去。

zh: 在任何地方
在…的各个地方；各处；处处
在所有…的情况下
en: in any place
ex: Sit wherever you like.
你爱坐在哪儿就坐哪儿。

zh: 刺激…的欲望；增强…的兴趣
en: to increase your desire for or interest in something
ex: The book will whet your appetite for more of her work.
你看了这本书就会更想多读她的著作。

zh: （表示迟疑或两个可能性之间的选择）是否
（表示两种情况都真实）是…（还是），或者…（或者），不管…（还是）
en: used to express a doubt or choice between two possibilities
ex: He seemed undecided whether to go or stay.
他似乎还没有决定去留。
